metrics.method: Manual read of all 356 non-service messages in data/chats/barbara-x-altr.jsonl (2026-07-20 → 2026-09-10); 197 from the client (Barb Brazil) and 159 from our side (Mayson, Michelle, Stephski, Olivia, Mica, Vivek, Derrek). 'Client question' = a client message containing an explicit ask whether or not punctuated with '?'; multi-message asks counted once (e.g. the Aug 24 escalation + pivot proposal counted as two). 'Unanswered >24h' = never answered at all, answered only after 24h, or answered with no substance — includes the Aug 6 check-in met with 'Yo Ma'am' and the Aug 27 OFTV-status ask that only moved after she re-asked four days later. 'Promise' = an explicit forward commitment by our side ('I'll create you…', 'will send you the @ name next week', 'let me get back on this', 'Yeah will do', 'we got it and will have it fixed'); one further promise is pending (Vivek's Sep 10 'Will do tomorrow', due Sep 11, unverified at close) and is excluded from kept/lapsed. max_team_silence_days is the longest gap between any two consecutive outbound messages from our side (Sep 4 16:25 → Sep 8 10:54 = 3.8d); topic-level silence is far larger — 17 days with zero Instagram messages from our side between her Aug 24 escalation and Mayson's Sep 10 question, and 29 days of owner silence (Derrek's last message Aug 12).
